mapper.sql: id, user_id AS userId, file_name AS fileName, file_path AS filePath, sheets_json AS sheetsJson, total_rows AS totalRows, create_time AS createTime
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO analysis_file (user_id, file_name, file_path, sheets_json, total_rows) VALUES (#{userId}, #{fileName}, #{filePath}, #{sheetsJson}, #{totalRows})
